title: Revisions
preamble: Past versions of this secret. Tap one to view or copy an old value.
copyBlocked: This version was a binary attachment, so there's no password to copy.
undecryptableBody: This version was encrypted for an identity you no longer have, so it can't be shown. It's still recorded in history.
deletedBody: The entry was removed in this revision.
attachmentBody: This version was a binary attachment. gpm doesn't export past attachment versions — open the entry to export the current one.
